Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated ferritin. There is also monocytosis and basophilia, with a slightly increased INR. Inflammatory markers (CRP, D-dimer) are within normal limits. These findings may suggest a chronic inflammatory or infectious process, possible bone marrow suppression, or systemic disease. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
